narrative.overview: Light uses a plain white canvas, dark ink, and a restrained blue accent drawn from the user's bencho.dev reference. Setup presents responding ESP devices with clear network guidance. A successful connection reveals one centered molded SVG rocker, without an outer tile or visible ON/OFF words.
dos: Do keep setup distinct from the connected single-switch view.
Do preserve the white canvas, ink typography, blue actions, and localized blue LED glow.
Do expose connection progress, errors, confirmed state, focus, busy semantics, and reduced-motion behavior.
donts: Don't add a dashboard, multiple switches, add/remove controls, or an outer switch tile.
Don't imply SSID scanning, automatic Wi-Fi joining, live hardware confirmation in preview, or push updates.
